Qualify the wing migration runner on an owner-authorized isolated full copy

Source: docs/BACKLOG.yaml; SHA256 1820106d0adc95b7edce8ca50853a3ced3ce19a5f49723d3d607a0b3fe8c687b
Original metadata: {"assignee": "owner", "key": "WING-MIGRATION-FULL-COPY-QUALIFICATION", "priority": "medium", "section_id": "storage_reliability", "size": "M", "status": "blocked", "summary": "Qualify the wing migration runner on an owner-authorized isolated full copy", "type": "task"}

Original accepted description (verbatim):
## Problem
Synthetic fixtures cannot prove preservation of the original rollout's complete Lance, KG,
sidecar, marker, and runtime state. The retained private inventory predates the final runner
contract and lacks source host/filesystem binding, normalized full-preimage evidence, and
owner-sealed installed-package identity.

## Blocker
Waits only on the owner-supplied private inventory and isolated full copy below. The runner
hardening from `WING-MIGRATION-FULL-COPY-RUNNER-HARDENING` landed on 2026-09-09.

## Scope
Refresh the exact private inventory against the landed runner schema and revision, then run
one owner-authorized rehearsal against the retained isolated full copy and both candidate KG
stores. Preserve the sealed receipt and qualification evidence. Do not mutate original paths,
activate the original marker, restart a watcher, or perform the live migration.

## Private operator input
Before launch, the operator exports `WING_MIGRATION_INVENTORY_PATH` with the absolute path to
the owner-authorized private inventory outside Git. Plan and implementation must read that exact
file and fail closed when the variable or file is absent. The path and private inventory values
must not be copied into tracked plans, logs, fixtures, or other public artifacts.

## Reuse ledger
capability | existing owner | completion evidence | residual delta | action
migration and recovery | temporary runner from `WING-MIGRATION-EXISTING-DESTINATION-GUARD` | synthetic qualification and focused tests | prove the same contract against complete private state | reuse
stored provenance identity | landed runner from `WING-MIGRATION-FULL-COPY-RUNNER-HARDENING` | lexical and relocation contract passes focused gates | verify the frozen behavior against real copied state | reuse
private state authority | owner-supplied inventory and isolated copy | supplied before implementation launch | validate exact copied targets and admit copy-only mutation | reuse

## Owner prerequisite
Refresh only the missing private authority fields against the landed runner schema. Bind
the current qualification host, source host/filesystem and snapshot manifest, normalized
origin-to-copy preimage, exact copied targets, installed runtime package hashes, final runner
digest, retention, and descendant authority. A missing or mismatched field must refuse before
mutation. Keep the private values outside Git and public logs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Owner supplies an exact inventory naming the isolated palace, repository, marker, runtime,
  source and destination wings, both KG candidates, snapshot roots, and evidence destination.
- [ ] Full-copy inventory seals the original logical source root separately from the copied
  project root. Collision, protected-row, and KG eligibility checks use that logical root;
  resolver and effective-mine probes use only a disposable copy of the copied project root.
  Stored source paths and hashes remain unchanged.
- [ ] Device/inode and full preimage checks prove the qualification targets do not overlap original
  paths, and all writers/readers are stopped and fenced before snapshot, apply, or recovery.
- [ ] The full-copy rehearsal proves exact union, collision handling, WAL-safe snapshot, duplicate
  retry, every staged interruption recovery, complete preservation, and no unrelated drift.
- [ ] The exact runtime resolves and effectively mines the destination wing on the copied tree.
  The runtime probe cannot mutate the full-copy state, and relocated absolute source paths do
  not substitute for the live original-path no-op check.
- [ ] Absence or mismatch of the private inventory produces a clear nonzero result and changes no
  state. One receipt-bound recovery command and the owner-controlled retention rule are recorded.
- [ ] Live execution remains blocked pending separate authority for the original host, original
  snapshots, mutation, marker activation, rollback, original-path no-op, and watcher restart.

exclusions: Do not mutate original paths, activate the original marker, restart a watcher, or perform the live migration.
Private inventory paths and values must remain outside Git and public artifacts.

Original accepted description (verbatim):
## Problem
Synthetic fixtures cannot prove preservation of the original rollout's complete Lance, KG,
sidecar, marker, and runtime state. The retained private inventory predates the final runner
contract and lacks source host/filesystem binding, normalized full-preimage evidence, and
owner-sealed installed-package identity.

## Blocker
Waits only on the owner-supplied private inventory and isolated full copy below. The runner
hardening from `WING-MIGRATION-FULL-COPY-RUNNER-HARDENING` landed on 2026-09-09.

## Scope
Refresh the exact private inventory against the landed runner schema and revision, then run
one owner-authorized rehearsal against the retained isolated full copy and both candidate KG
stores. Preserve the sealed receipt and qualification evidence. Do not mutate original paths,
activate the original marker, restart a watcher, or perform the live migration.

## Private operator input
Before launch, the operator exports `WING_MIGRATION_INVENTORY_PATH` with the absolute path to
the owner-authorized private inventory outside Git. Plan and implementation must read that exact
file and fail closed when the variable or file is absent. The path and private inventory values
must not be copied into tracked plans, logs, fixtures, or other public artifacts.

## Reuse ledger
capability | existing owner | completion evidence | residual delta | action
migration and recovery | temporary runner from `WING-MIGRATION-EXISTING-DESTINATION-GUARD` | synthetic qualification and focused tests | prove the same contract against complete private state | reuse
stored provenance identity | landed runner from `WING-MIGRATION-FULL-COPY-RUNNER-HARDENING` | lexical and relocation contract passes focused gates | verify the frozen behavior against real copied state | reuse
private state authority | owner-supplied inventory and isolated copy | supplied before implementation launch | validate exact copied targets and admit copy-only mutation | reuse

## Owner prerequisite
Refresh only the missing private authority fields against the landed runner schema. Bind
the current qualification host, source host/filesystem and snapshot manifest, normalized
origin-to-copy preimage, exact copied targets, installed runtime package hashes, final runner
digest, retention, and descendant authority. A missing or mismatched field must refuse before
mutation. Keep the private values outside Git and public logs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Owner supplies an exact inventory naming the isolated palace, repository, marker, runtime,
  source and destination wings, both KG candidates, snapshot roots, and evidence destination.
- [ ] Full-copy inventory seals the original logical source root separately from the copied
  project root. Collision, protected-row, and KG eligibility checks use that logical root;
  resolver and effective-mine probes use only a disposable copy of the copied project root.
  Stored source paths and hashes remain unchanged.
- [ ] Device/inode and full preimage checks prove the qualification targets do not overlap original
  paths, and all writers/readers are stopped and fenced before snapshot, apply, or recovery.
- [ ] The full-copy rehearsal proves exact union, collision handling, WAL-safe snapshot, duplicate
  retry, every staged interruption recovery, complete preservation, and no unrelated drift.
- [ ] The exact runtime resolves and effectively mines the destination wing on the copied tree.
  The runtime probe cannot mutate the full-copy state, and relocated absolute source paths do
  not substitute for the live original-path no-op check.
- [ ] Absence or mismatch of the private inventory produces a clear nonzero result and changes no
  state. One receipt-bound recovery command and the owner-controlled retention rule are recorded.
- [ ] Live execution remains blocked pending separate authority for the original host, original
  snapshots, mutation, marker activation, rollback, original-path no-op, and watcher restart.

exclusions: Do not mutate original paths, activate the original marker, restart a watcher, or perform the live migration.
Private inventory paths and values must remain outside Git and public artifacts.
